query:
SELECT
                pm.data_source_id,
                pm.accession,
                v.id as version_id,
                v.version_major,
                v.version_minor
            FROM protein_metadata pm
            JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = pm.data_source_id
            JOIN versions v ON v.entry_id = ds.id
            WHERE pm.accession = ANY($1)
            ORDER BY pm.accession, v.version_major DESC, v.version_minor DESC
